_comment: Axio sends bill notices, repayment confirmations and loan marketing.
WHY generic_fallback IS false AND THE IGNORES MATTER: 'We have received
your repayment ... You got a Personal loan upto Rs 4,00,000' contains the
word 'received' and an amount. Allowlisting this sender without both guards
lets the generic credit template match it and invent a 4 lakh rupee income.
'Thank you for availing Pay Later credit of Rs274.0' is a REAL purchase: the
lender pays the merchant, so it produces no bank SMS anywhere and is
invisible unless captured here. The same caution applies to the other side --
the monthly repayment leaves a bank account and must be a `transfer`, or the
The message names no merchant, so 'Pay Later' is the only payee available.
A field pattern extracts from the text; it cannot inject a constant.
